_about: John William Mackail (1859-1945). Classical scholarship (lane B pivot of 2026-10-10 from translations to public-domain English scholarship on the classics): Latin Literature, clean Gutenberg; Lectures on Greek Poetry (Longmans, 1910), raw IA OCR. His translations (Virgil, Catullus, the Greek Anthology, the Odyssey) are on those shelves. No uids minted. Round dw (2026-10-23) added, raw IA OCR with title pages read: The Springs of Helicon (1909); Virgil and his Meaning to the World of To-day (Boston: Marshall Jones, 1922); Classical Studies (John Murray, first edition; IA dates it 1925). His Select Epigrams is on greek-lyric and his Virgil and Odyssey translations on the virgil and homer shelves.
